## About
Road Runners Performance & Accessory Center is your local dealer and installer for truck, Jeep, SUV, off road and performance parts in Avenel, right in Middlesex County. We carry everything from tonneau covers and lift kits to exhaust systems and computer tuners, from names like Warn, Rancho, MagnaFlow and BF Goodrich.
We install everything we sell at our own shop, so you are not left with a box of parts and a weekend of guesswork. We are your neighbors, and we would rather earn your trust than make a quick sale. Our customers have given us a 4.7 rating from 167 Google reviews.

## Services
- Lift kits and lowering kits: Lift kits and lowering kits, plus bug shields, Nerf bars and grill guards, sold and installed.
- Exhaust systems, air intakes and tuners: Exhaust systems, air intakes, computer tuners and more for domestic and import cars and trucks.
- Commercial contractor truck storage: Tool boxes, ladder racks, van shelving and other storage for work trucks and vans, installed by our crew.
- Towing accessories: Trailer hitches, goosenecks, fifth wheel setups, brake controllers and wiring for towing.

## FAQ
Q: Do you install the parts you sell?
A: Yes. We professionally install everything we sell at our shop in Avenel.

Q: Do you work on Jeep and truck builds?
A: That is a big part of what we do. We are a truck and Jeep accessory center, and we install the parts we carry.

Q: Is the shop easy to get to?
A: Yes. We are on St Georges Ave in Avenel, close to NJ Turnpike Exit 11.
